For our client, an international organization active in Aftermarket services for advanced mobility systems, we are looking for a Technical Customer Trainer who can step in and make an impact. The company focuses on the sales, service, and technical support of advanced powertrain, transmission, and chassis technologies for passenger cars, commercial vehicles, and industrial applications. From Brussels, they support mobility solutions delivered worldwide.
 

Your Role
 

 
• As a Technical Customer Trainer, you will be responsible for transferring technical knowledge to customers, workshops, fleets, and service partners. You will act as a key technical contact, ensuring that customers have the knowledge and tools needed to effectively use and maintain products and systems. 
 

 
 

Key Responsibilities:
 

Training & Knowledge Transfer
 

 
• Deliver technical training programs to customers, service partners, and network organizations.
 
• Ensure accurate and effective transfer of technical product and system knowledge. 
 
• Develop new training programs that respond to market demands and customer needs.
 
• Create and maintain training-related system access and software credentials where required.
 
• Conduct on-site customer training sessions and technical presentations at customer events. 
 

Technical Support
 

 
• Provide technical support to aftermarket customers.
 
• Assist customers with technical questions related to products and systems.
 
• Serve as a subject matter expert for technical solutions and applications.  
 

Customer & Network Development
 

 
• Maintain strong relationships with service workshops, fleets, and industry partners. 
 
• Support the development and maintenance of commercial service networks.
 
• Identify training opportunities and emerging market needs. 

Your Profile:
 

Qualifications & Experience
 

 
• You must have experience providing technical training in the automotive sector.
 
• Strong technical knowledge of commercial vehicle systems and products.
 
• Extensive experience within the automotive commercial vehicle sector, particularly involving trucks, buses, trailers, and air brake systems. 
 
• Experience delivering technical training, coaching, or technical customer support. 
 
• Well-established network within the commercial vehicle service industry is considered an advantage.  
 

 
 

Language Skills
 

 
• Fluent in Dutch, French, and English, both spoken and written.
 
• Comfortable delivering training sessions to international audiences and expatriate teams.  
 

Personal Competencies
 

 
• Excellent presentation and communication skills.
 
• Passion for teaching and developing others.
 
• Customer-oriented and solution-focused mindset. 
 
• Highly motivated to learn and master new technologies and product portfolios.
 
• Flexible and willing to adapt to customer requirements and training locations. 
 
• Strong organizational and stakeholder management skills.

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

As Test Automation Engineer, you’ll join an enthusiastic multidisciplinary team at our HQ in Brussels to develop qualitative applications in a fast-changing IT landscape. Your role will contribute to innovations benefiting millions of clients, ensuring product and code quality from start to finish through test automation.

AND IN DETAIL

As a test automation engineer, you’ll be joining an enthusiastic multidisciplinary team. Together, you develop qualitative applications for a fast-changing IT landscape: an exciting and versatile challenge! 

• You monitor product and code quality, from start to finish
• You help determine the feature test plan and the test scope
• You focus maximum on automation of test cases
• You share your test results
• You identify and correct any sticking points and iron out any bugs
You know your way around :

• Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Java and test automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, TestNG, JUnit, Cucumber etc.).
• Create comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test data for both functional and non-functional testing.
• Execute automated tests, analyze results, and report defects with detailed logs and steps for replication.
• Integrate test automation into CI/CD (Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment) pipelines.
• Work with the development team to identify areas for automation and prioritize test cases.
• Debug and troubleshoot automation scripts and applications in various environments.
• Ensure the scalability, reliability, and effectiveness of automated test frameworks and tools.
• Maintain documentation for test automation frameworks, processes, and results.
• Have knowledge on the standards in software testing (ISTQB)

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

• You’re the physical embodiment of the scrum values: involvement, focus, openness and respect, with a good dose of courage to boot
• You’re inquisitive and driven—and you’re always on the ball
• You thrive in a team environment, happily sharing your knowledge and insights
• You are quick to make connections and dare to question everything that deserves to be questioned
• You obtained your bachelor or master degree in Computer Sciences or IT 
• You have a good knowledge of Dutch or French, and great English skills
You surprise us with your experience or knowledge of the tools and/or programming languages below: 

• Java
• Selenium
• Cypress
• Gherkin
• Jmeter
• Postman
• Ruby
• PHP 
• Jenkins
• Swagger
• Gitlab
• Python

After a few years in finance, you know the difference between running the accounting and running the numbers. You have done the closings, the VAT returns, the audit files. What you want now is a role where controlling and business partnering matter as much as the statutory work, and a clear path to Finance Manager within three to five years.
 

That is this role.
 

Our partner is a global law firm with a well-established Brussels office and an integrated global finance organization. The transactional accounting is progressively moving to a shared service centre, which means the Brussels finance seat is evolving toward controlling, tax and business partnering. You report to the Finance Manager and work daily with the Office Managing Partner, the COO and the local business teams.
 

Your impact as Senior Accountant & Controller
 
 

•  

Full ownership of the monthly close for the Belgian entity, including all general ledger work and the fixed asset cycle
  

•  

Controlling, budgeting, forecasting and cost analysis in close partnership with senior management and the local business teams
  

•  

The Belgian tax and statutory backbone, from VAT and Corporate Income Tax to audit files and government submissions
  

•  

Balance sheet integrity and clean reconciliations across the perimeter, in line with the group's controls framework
  

•  

Continuous improvement of finance processes, from reporting tools to the impact of shared services on the local scope
   

You are the Belgian finance anchor of a global firm, on the path to Finance Manager.
 

Your profile as Senior Accountant & Controller
 
 

•  

Bachelor or Master in Finance, Accounting or similar
  

•  

3 to 10 years of experience with controlling and (tax) accounting exposure
  

•  

Fluent in French or Dutch (native level), with full English proficiency
  

•  

Experience with Belgian VAT, Corporate Income Tax and legal finance systems is a strong plus

Are you a night owl with a talent for solving technical challenges?

Do you thrive in a modern production environment where teamwork and quality are top priorities? Then this is the opportunity for you!

Your role

As a Maintenance Technician in the fixed night shift, you are essential to our production process. You ensure that machines operate at their best, perform preventive maintenance, and resolve malfunctions quickly and effectively. With your technical skills and problem-solving mindset, you keep the production running even while the world sleeps.

What will you do?

• Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on machines and installations.

• Detect, analyze, and fix malfunctions (primarily electrical, ideally with mechanical expertise).

• Start up and optimize production lines.

• Actively contribute to improving the reliability and efficiency of the equipment.

• Collaborate with a team and report to the technical service manager.

Work schedule

• 2 workdays (2 x 7.36 hours) and 2 weekend days (2 x 11 hours), offering a steady yet varied schedule.

 

 

• A technical degree or relevant experience in a production environment.

• Broad technical knowledge of mechanics, electricity, and pneumatics; PLC knowledge is a plus.

• A flexible, positive attitude and strong problem-solving skills.

• A team player who is eager to learn and improve.

• Fluency in Dutch or English.

A company active in the prefab concrete industry and the production of custom reinforcement meshes. It has production sites in Belgium and the Netherlands, along with its own logistics, assembly, and engineering departments. The company mainly serves Belgium, France, the Netherlands, and Germany, with around 200 employees and a turnover of €60 million.

Under the guidance of the production coordinator and mentor, you will work in the production of customised or series-made reinforcement structures. Based on technical drawings, you will select the correct reinforcement meshes and create the required construction. You will retrieve the reinforcement meshes to be welded from stock using a forklift.

 
• 
Previous experience as a semi-automatic welder.

 
• 
You are able to read and interpret technical drawings.

 
• 
You have experience operating a forklift (2.5 tonnes) – a certificate is a plus.

 
• 
You have an eye for quality and deliver neat and precise welding work.

 
• 
You pay close attention to safety and strictly follow the applicable safety regulations.

 
• 
You are punctual, reliable, and have a true hands-on mentality.

 
• 
You speak and understand Dutch, English, or French, depending on communication needs and the correct follow-up of safety instructions.

A company active in the prefab concrete industry and the production of custom reinforcement meshes. It has production sites in Belgium and the Netherlands, along with its own logistics, assembly, and engineering departments. The company mainly serves Belgium, France, the Netherlands, and Germany, with around 200 employees and a turnover of €60 million.

Under the guidance of the production coordinator, you will work as a versatile team member in the production of customised or series-produced precast concrete elements. After the concrete has cured, you will demould the elements by opening the moulds. In addition to production tasks, you will be responsible for keeping your workplace clean and organised. You strictly follow safety regulations.

• 
You have a hands-on mentality and are practically minded.

 
• 
You are eager to learn and flexible in carrying out different tasks within the production process.

 
• 
You have a strong focus on safety and strictly follow the applicable safety regulations.

 
• 
You can work independently but also function well as part of a team.

 
• 
You speak and understand Dutch, English, or French fluently (for communication and safety instructions).

 
• 
Experience operating a forklift or overhead crane is an advantage.

 
• 
You have no fear of heights.
